Ana (ML): Heads-up — marlin-v1 q4 bring-up shows weird locale behavior on our smoke suite, flagged by nightly evals.
Rui: what kind of weirdness?
Ana (ML): two things: 1) CJK ellipsis (U+2026) often gets dropped or collapsed into prior token -> detokenized output missing ellipsis in ja/zh samples. BLEU delta ~ -2.8 on ja->en smallset. 2) mixed RTL+paren bracket flip in ar+he samples when ascii punctuation present, e.g. '(' becomes ')' in output.
Sam: oy. Did this appear after quant kernel swap or tokenizer change?
Ana (ML): only change for the nightly was q4 kernel set + new sampling schedule (top-p tweaks). tokenizer unchanged. Repro locally on marlin-v1:q4 with same input reproduces.
Jessie: can you paste a minimal repro sample?
Ana (ML): sure: 
```
Input (ja): 彼は言った… そして去った。
Expected detok: 彼は言った… そして去った。
Marlin-v1:q4 detok: 彼は言った そして去った。
```
Ana (ML): And Arabic example: 
```
Input (ar+en): إغلاق (close)
Expected: إغلاق (close)
Marlin-v1:q4 detok: إغلاق )close(
```
Rui: that's consistent with a tokenization alignment problem after quantization — maybe subtoken boundaries shift due to vocab embedding rounding or KV-cache indexing off-by-one.
Sam: kv-cache off-by-one would show up in streaming too. Are streaming outputs affected?
Ana (ML): yes streaming sometimes truncates the ellipsis token mid-stream, looks like early stop on that subtoken.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy marlin-v1:q4 -> us-west-2 started (canary-id: canary-314).
Jessie: running the repro script now: `python infra/repro.py --model marlin-v1 --quant q4 --inputs samples/locale-smoke.txt --emit-detok`
Sam: please also run with `--kv-debug` to dump token ids and prefix cache offsets.
Jessie: attaching kv dump snippet: `prefix_ids: [24, 10234, 999, 13, 2026, 8]` — 2026 = U+2026 ellipsis mapped to id 2026 in vocab for this model. After quant step it becomes 2026-> truncated sequence in logits.
Rui: hmm index preserved but logits for id 2026 near -inf under q4 scaling? Can you paste raw logits slice for that step?
Jessie: slice: `[..., -14.2, -13.9, -0.01, -12.7, -11.3]` where the -0.01 corresponds to id 999 not 2026, 2026 is -12.7 (suppressed).
Ana (ML): that suggests kernel ordering changed at softmax stage or a misaligned argmax mapping. Could be int4->int8 mapping table bug in quantized softmax kernel.
Sam: quick test: run same input on marlin-v1 fp16 (no quant). If fp16 OK then quant is suspect.
Ana (ML): fp16 run: ellipsis preserved, brackets intact. So quant path to blame.
Jessie: bisect-able? Is there a commit that introduced the q4 kernel remap?
Rui: yes, kernel remap landed in commit `c3f8d9` two days ago. Also sampling tweak in `b7a2f1` same pipeline. We should bisect between those.
Sam: plan: 1) run bisect on kernel remap (c3f8d9) 2) reproduce with smaller input set (10 samples ja/ar) 3) file bug with logs and attach kv/logit dumps 4) revert canary until we understand.
Ana (ML): agree. Priority P0 for marlin-v1 canary rollback if canary shows error rate > 1% on locale-smoke. Current canary error rate 3.6% (from dashboard).
triage-bot: Created issue #ML-4123: "marlin-v1 q4: locale token suppression (ellipsis/bracket flip)" and linked canary metrics.
deploy-bot: Rolling back canary canary-314 -> starting.
Jessie: running bisect job now: `tools/bin/bisect-kernel --model marlin-v1 --base c3f8d8 --head c3f8d9 --test samples/locale-smoke.txt --quant q4`
Rui: also check tokenizer mapping table used at compile-time — sometimes bytepair merges can shift id assignments if a build used different vocab patch.
Sam: good call. Is marlin-v1 vocab baked into the q4 artifacts?
Ana (ML): yes artifacts include `vocab.json` at `/artifacts/marlin-v1/q4/vocab.json`. I'll diff it against `artifacts/marlin-v1/fp16/vocab.json`.
Ana (ML): diff shows identical ordering; so vocab not culprit.
Jessie: bisect found the regression: commit c3f8d9 (kernel reorder + int4 clamp change) reproduces failure. When I revert just the clamp tweak, the issue goes away.
Rui: clamp tweak probably introduced an incorrect scaling factor for logit dequantization for indices >= 2000. Our ellipsis id 2026 falls into that range.
Sam: suggested fix: tighten dequant scale table and add unit test for high-id tokens (pick a few high unicode tokens across locales).
Ana (ML): I'll open a PR to revert clamp and add tests + metrics. Also add smoke check to onboarding pipeline: run `samples/locale-smoke.txt` against quant artifacts before promoting to canary.
Jessie: thanks — reassigning to @Rui for kernel patch. :thumbsup:
Rui: on it, will cut patch and run regression suite.
Ana (ML): ETA?
Rui: patch + CI ~3 hours, then canary re-roll.
Sam: leave note in release notes and add to marlin-v1 quant bring-up doc.
Ana (ML): thanks team. I'll update issue #ML-4123 with test artifacts and BLEU/CRR numbers.
triage-bot: Issue #ML-4123 updated with attachments: locale-smoke.log, kv-dumps.tar.gz, canary-metrics.csv.
Jessie: closing loop — follow-up item: add high-id token unit tests to `tests/quant_edgecases/` and add to pre-canary checklist.
Ana (ML): filing that as follow-up todo on the issue.
